# 4 Ezra Chapter 2 — The LOGOS Bible (Formal)
**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** Latin Vulgate (Codex Sangermanensis) | **Section:** 5th Ezra (Christian addition)

---

**1** Thus says the LORD: I brought this people out of bondage, and I gave them my commandments through my servants the prophets, whom they would not hear but made void my counsel.

**2** The mother who bore them says to them: Go, my children, for I am widowed and forsaken. I reared you with gladness, but I have lost you with mourning and sorrow,

**3** because you sinned before the LORD God and did evil before me.

**4** But now what can I do for you? I am widowed and forsaken. Go, my children, and ask for mercy from the LORD.

**5** But I call upon you, Father, as witness over the mother of these children, because they would not keep my covenant,

**6** that you would bring confusion upon them and bring their mother to ruin, so that they may have no offspring.

**7** Let them be scattered among the nations; let their names be blotted out from the earth, because they have despised my covenant.

**8** Woe to you, Assyria, who conceals the unrighteous! O evil nation, remember what I did to Sodom and Gomorrah,

**9** whose land lies in clumps of pitch and mounds of ashes! So also I will deal with those who have not heard me, says the LORD Almighty.

**10** Thus says the LORD to Ezra: Tell my people that I will give them the kingdom of Jerusalem, which I was prepared to give to Israel.

**11** Moreover, I will take back to myself their glory and will give to these the everlasting habitations which I had prepared for those.

**12** The tree of life shall be as a sweet fragrance to them; they shall neither labor nor grow weary.

**13** Ask and you shall receive; pray for few days for yourselves, that they may be shortened; the kingdom is already prepared for you — watch!

**14** Call, O heaven and earth, to witness: for I blotted out evil and created good, says the LORD Almighty.

**15** Let the mother embrace her children; raise them with gladness as a dove; strengthen their feet, for I have chosen you, says the LORD Almighty.

**16** And those who are dead I will raise up from their places, and bring them out from their tombs, for I have recognized my name in them.

**17** Do not fear, O mother of children, for I have chosen you, says the LORD Almighty.

**18** For your help I will send my servants Isaiah and Jeremiah, at whose counsel I have sanctified and prepared for you twelve trees laden with various fruits,

**19** and as many springs flowing with milk and honey, and seven mighty mountains upon which roses and lilies grow, by which I will fill your children with joy.

**20** Do right by the widow, judge on behalf of the fatherless, give to the poor, defend the orphan, clothe the naked,

**21** heal the broken and the weak, do not mock the lame, protect the crippled, and let the blind man receive the vision of my brightness.

**22** Protect the old and the young within your walls.

**23** Whenever you find the dead, mark them and commit them to the tomb, and I will give you the first place in my resurrection.

**24** Rest and be at peace, my people, for your rest shall come.

**25** Good nurse, nourish your children; strengthen their feet.

**26** Not one of the servants I have given you shall perish, for I will require them from among your number.

**27** Do not be troubled; when the day of trouble and anguish comes, others shall weep and be sorrowful, but you shall have delight and abundance.

**28** All nations shall envy you but shall be powerless against you, says the LORD Almighty.

**29** My hands shall protect you so that your children shall not see hell.

**30** Rejoice, O mother, with your children, for I will deliver you, says the LORD Almighty.

**31** Remember your children that sleep, for I will bring them out from the hidden places of the earth and show mercy to them, for I am merciful, says the LORD Almighty.

**32** Embrace your children until I come and proclaim mercy to them; for my springs run over and my grace shall not fail.

**33** I, Ezra, received a command from the LORD on Mount Horeb to go to Israel. When I came to them they rejected me and spurned the commandment of the LORD.

**34** Therefore I say to you, O nations who hear and understand: Await your shepherd; he will give you everlasting rest, for the one who is to come at the end of the age is near.

**35** Be ready for the rewards of the kingdom, for the eternal light shall shine upon you forevermore.

**36** Flee the shadow of this age; receive the joy of your glory — I call my Savior openly to witness.

**37** Receive what is entrusted to you and be joyful, giving thanks to him who called you to the heavenly kingdoms.

**38** Arise, stand, and see the number of those who are sealed at the feast of the LORD:

**39** those who have withdrawn from the shadow of this world have received glorious garments from the LORD.

**40** Take again your full number, O Zion, and close the roll of those of yours who are clothed in white, who have fulfilled the law of the LORD.

**41** The number of your children whom you desired is complete; implore the power of the LORD that your people, called from the beginning, may be made holy.

**42** I, Ezra, saw on Mount Zion a great multitude that I could not count, and they all praised the LORD with songs.

**43** In their midst was a young man of great stature, taller than all the rest, who placed crowns on the head of each of them and grew still taller; I was awestruck.

**44** Then I asked an angel: Who are these, my lord?

**45** He answered me: These are they who have put off the mortal garment and have put on the immortal; they have confessed the name of God, and now they are crowned and receive palms.

**46** Then I asked the angel: Who is that young man who places crowns upon them and puts palms in their hands?

**47** He answered me: He is the Son of God, whom they confessed in the world. Then I began to praise those who had stood so valiantly for the name of the LORD.

**48** Then the angel said to me: Go, tell my people how great and how many are the wonders of the LORD God which you have seen.
